services.name: Helen Flow Collector
services.description: Retrieves, processes, and exports your electricity consumption data and spot price history from Helen.fi to local databases. Excellent for tracking hourly spot price impacts.

services.name: EleniaFlow Collector
services.description: Reads your Elenia Aina metering points and exports consumption with Nord Pool spot prices to InfluxDB. Resolves down to 5-minute values straight from the meter registers, only minutes behind live.

services.name: Ruuvi Gateway
services.description: Receives, parses, and forwards Bluetooth BLE advertisements from RuuviTag environmental sensors. Monitor real-time temperature, humidity, and pressure across your property.

services.name: FingridFlow
services.description: Retrieves, browses, and exports grid metrics from the Fingrid Open Data API (frequency, wind, solar, nuclear, etc.) to InfluxDB. Features interactive live-preview charts.
